title: Bar chart
description: A title, labels and one series. The best value is labeled; every bar is focusable and opens its tooltip on hover and focus. prefix and notation format the axis, tooltips and table.

title: Lines and areas
description: Two or more series get a legend in the header and take --apui-chart-1…6 in order. The actions slot holds header controls, such as Tabs that switch the range.

title: Donut with a data table
description: A donut of one series' values, its legend listing each slice's share. tabular adds the data table view under the plot.
